categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Carries the maintainers' Validation label and modifies block validation state error handling in ConnectBlock and ActivateBestChainStep within src/validation.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents hybrid BlockValidationState objects and redundant fatal error notifications during error handling in block connection and tip disconnection. As noted in the description, calling Error() on an already non-valid state changes the mode while preserving old reject reasons, resulting in a confusing mix of error details and complicating refactoring to pass validation states by value (#35570).
